Interface HttpBodyRouteSpec<B extends @Nullable Object>

Type Parameters:
B - The type of the body the handler receives
All Superinterfaces:
ExecutionSpec<HttpBodyRouteSpec<B>>, RouteFilterSpec<HttpBodyRouteSpec<B>>, RouteSpec<HttpBodyRouteSpec<B>>
All Known Subinterfaces:
LocatedHttpBodyRouteSpec<T,B>
public sealed interface HttpBodyRouteSpec<B extends @Nullable Object> extends RouteSpec<HttpBodyRouteSpec<B>> permits LocatedHttpBodyRouteSpec<T,B> (not exhaustive)
A pending route whose handler receives the body of the request, after a body stage of HttpRouteSpec: HttpRouteSpec.body(Argument), HttpRouteSpec.body() or HttpRouteSpec.form(). It takes the settings of a route, see RouteSpec, and ends with one terminal, which adds the route. 
routes.POST("/items").body(Item.class).handle((request, pathVariables, item) -> HttpResponse.created(items.save(item)));
routes.POST("/items/async").body(Item.class).handleAsync((request, pathVariables, item) ->
    items.saveAsync(item).thenApply(HttpResponse::created));
routes.POST("/login").form().handle((request, pathVariables, form) -> login(form.getString("user")));
